Breaking down a whole bull into large cuts, separating ribs, bones and meat before moving each part into different cooking methods!🥩🔪
Roasting ribs, simmering bones and stewing meat while serving a full village style feast from one animal across the day!🍖🔥

This video is intended for educational and culinary purposes only. It shows traditional butchering techniques used in food preparation. Viewer discretion is advised, as some scenes may be graphic. All procedures shown are part of the responsible use of animal products for cooking and are not intended to offend or disturb.
